svg.title: A labeled reduced cardiac wave and its sensor arrivals
svg.desc: New homogeneous one-dimensional Mitchell–Schaeffer reaction–diffusion calculation on a20mm sealed strand. Voltage is dimensionless. A fixed-width2ms stimulus starts at1ms. The dashed levelv=0.5defines interpolated arrival; this window shows the propagating front, not the complete repolarization cycle.
